title: Simple 3D
description: Adds various 3D models while staying true to the vanilla textures
body:
# About
Simple 3D changes the flat vanila textrues into high-quality 3D models while staying true to the original art style. The pack focuses mostly on decorations and non-block objects like ladders, rails, and crops. However, some blocks were given increased detail where depth is implyed in the texture.
